A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TruthPrInt/ComnHallu work. Their complete main texts, Figures 1–9, Tables 1–9, Algorithm 1, and Appendices A–C are readable and support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original hallucination detection, transfer, CHAIR/POPE evaluation, ablation, and caption case-study results in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark evaluations, ablations, appendix POPE results, and qualitative caption examples.

M1.justification: Sections 3–4 and Algorithm 1 retain the same preceding-token hidden states, three-layer hallucination detector, ComnHallu subspace alignment, and confidence-based traceback procedure. The revised schematics do not change the method.

E1.justification: CC-Sbu-Align collection/training and MSCOCO CHAIR, original/offline POPE, and LLaVA-Bench evaluation coverage are unchanged. The same cross-dataset and cross-model transfer scenarios are retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership matches within Tables 1–3 and 8–9 and the qualitative examples. Nullu remains in the CHAIR comparison, and HALC, printed as HACL in Tables 1–2 in both versions, is unchanged.

E3.justification: Both retain the 80/20 detector split, 500-image evaluation sampling, model configurations, metrics, offline POPE procedure, and default inference settings. Appendix A.2 also preserves the same detector training protocol.

E4.justification: Both retain the subspace-transfer, threshold/diversity, caption-length, traceback-count, efficiency, and hidden-layer analyses. Appendix B.1's preceding-confidence analysis and the caption case studies are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both specify three repetitions and reporting of averages and standard deviations. The uncertainty displays are retained, with no added run-count, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-testing information.

E6.justification: Corresponding numerical results, plotted findings, and qualitative examples match, including appendix POPE and preceding-confidence results. For example, Table 1 retains TruthPrInt's MiniGPT-4 CHAIRS of 16.87±0.87 and CHAIRI of 7.53±0.33.

T1.justification: The detection risk, covariance/eigendecomposition, subspace alignment equations, and decoding objective in Sections 3–4 are unchanged. Appendix definitions are retained, with no added or revised proofs or formal assumptions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about high-specificity internal-state indicators, shared hallucination subspaces, transferable mitigation, and superiority over baselines. Expanding LVLM in the title does not alter their scope.

C2.justification: The low-confidence trigger explanation, truthfulness/diversity tradeoff, and caveats about imperfect trigger identification remain unchanged. The shortened middle-layer discussion preserves its interpretation and supporting citations.

D1.justification: Detector architecture, optimizer, learning rate, batch size, training duration, inference hyperparameters, and A40 hardware disclosure are unchanged. Both retain the same repository address and future code-release statement.

R1.justification: The same 65 references and substantive related-work positioning are retained, including comparisons with contrastive decoding, post-processing, and Nullu. No cited work is added or removed.

P1.justification: v3 expands LVLM in the main and supplementary titles, makes small wording and grammatical edits, changes appendix-reference phrasing, and adds a funding acknowledgment. The section order and overall narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Existing figures, notably Figures 3, 4, and 7, are resized or restyled, and text flow and spacing change. Printed page numbers are removed. No figure or table is added or removed, and the displayed scientific content is retained.

improvement.justification: v3 provides limited editorial polish, figure-formatting adjustments, and a funding acknowledgment. The scientific argument, results, reproducibility information, and appendix evidence remain unchanged. The presentation edits do not produce a meaningful net difference in clarity or evidential support.
